paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.62 as of August 24, 2026, with a decrease of 5.07% from the prior close and 22.27% over the last 21 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.
Recent news includes a headline from Stocktwits on August 24, 2026, where Fermi Cofounder Toby Neugebauer discussed market support for cooperation between him and the company's board.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a Form 4 on August 18, 2026, and a Form 10-Q on August 14, 2026, which reported a net loss for the second quarter of 2026. Additionally, Fermi Inc. appointed Lee McIntire as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, as disclosed in an 8-K filing on August 13, 2026.
